features.label: Log rank
features.desc: the ranking level itself (rankings far down the list move more)

features.label: Ranking v model
features.desc: log official rank minus log of the rank the model implies, shrunk by matches played

features.label: Age
features.desc: age at the snapshot, centred at 25

features.label: Age squared
features.desc: the curvature of the age curve

features.label: Age unknown
features.desc: 1 when there is no date of birth

features.label: Elo trend
features.desc: Elo change over the last 6 months, in 100s

features.label: Rank trend
features.desc: log rank change over the last 6 months

features.label: Days out
features.desc: log(1 + days since the last rated match)

features.label: Activity
features.desc: log(1 + rated matches in the last 12 months)

features.label: Points to defend
features.desc: tour-level points that drop within the horizon / official points

features.label: Tour-level share
features.desc: tour-level points in the ranking / official points (low = built on Challengers / ITF)

features.label: Close-match luck
features.desc: close-match luck per match over the last 12 months

features.label: Draw luck
features.desc: draw luck per match over the last 12 months

features.label: Market v Elo
features.desc: the closing market's rating of the player minus Elo's, last 12 months, in 100s of Elo points
